description: Solve a pricing triangle: given exactly two of cost, price, gross margin percent, and markup percent, derive the other two plus the gross profit. Margin is profit as a share of the selling price (profit / price) while markup is profit as a share of the cost (profit / cost), so a 20% margin equals a 25% markup. Margin plus markup alone cannot be solved, since neither carries an absolute amount.

cost.description: Unit cost (what you pay). Provide exactly two of the four fields.

marginPercent.description: Gross margin as a percent of the selling price (must be below 100)

markupPercent.description: Markup as a percent of the cost (must be greater than -100)

price.description: Selling price (what the customer pays). Provide exactly two of the four fields.

name: calculate_margin_markup
